unlist.para: Subject to the approval of the Authority, the operator may use a procedure for the extension of the applicable Repair Interval B, C, and D, for the same duration as specified in the MEL, provided that:

item.para: A description of specific duties and responsibilities for controlling extensions is established by the operator and accepted by the Authority, and
The operator only grants a one-time extension of the applicable Repair Interval, and
The Authority is notified of any extension granted within a timescale acceptable to the Authority, and
Repair is accomplished at the earliest opportunity.
